faq.question: Q1. What posts are available in the HP JSV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Para Pump Operator, Para Fitter, and Para Multi-purpose Worker positions within the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced by HP JSV?
faq.answer: There are a total of 40 vacancies available across the different posts in this recruitment drive by HP JSV.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date for interested and eligible candidates to submit their offline application forms is 20 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for HP JSV Various Posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply for these positions through the offline mode by sending their completed application forms to the specified address.

faq.question: Q5. What are the age limits for applying to the HP JSV recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must be at least 18 years old and not older than 45 years as of the specified cut-off date for these vacancies.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the recruited posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates ranges from Rs. 6000/- to Rs. 7100/- per month, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have Matriculation (10th) with an ITI certificate for some posts, while others require a Middle pass or equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the HP JSV recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates, for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these HP JSV posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves evaluating marks from Matriculation/Middle, BPL family marks, experience marks, and includes a skill test and physical test.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the job location be for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected candidates will be in Himachal Pradesh, specifically in Shimla, as per the organization's jurisdiction.
